recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中顆粒周圍有大量中型、細胞質淡灰藍無顆粒、核染色質細緻的母細胞（箭頭），在紅血球前驅細胞與小淋巴球之間明顯增多，是 BPDCN 骨髓侵犯的低倍樣貌。
features: Cellular aspirate particle with increased medium-sized blasts (arrow)
Blasts with round to indented nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm
Scattered admixed erythroid precursors, small lymphocytes and occasional granulocytes
Several cells with more deeply basophilic cytoplasm; fat spaces present
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows a cellular particle with an increased population of medium-sized blasts (arrow) that have round to indented nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm. Residual trilineage hematopoiesis, including erythroid precursors and maturing granulocytes, and small lymphocytes are admixed. Fine cytologic detail such as vacuoles is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a blastic neoplasm, compatible with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm with immunophenotypic confirmation.

ddx.vs: AML blasts often show granules or Auer rods and express MPO/CD34/CD117, whereas BPDCN blasts are agranular and CD123/TCL1/CD4/CD56-positive.
Lymphoblasts are TdT-positive with B or T lineage markers and have scantier cytoplasm.
Hematogones are small cells with homogeneous chromatin and scant cytoplasm showing a maturation spectrum on flow cytometry, not large blasts with gray-blue cytoplasm.
